high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from the account "wehavethedata." The post was made 20 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The content of the post is an article titled "This chart of ocean temperatures should really scare you" by Benji Jones, published on February 28, 2024, at 3:40 PM GMT-5. The main focus of the image is a map of the North Atlantic Ocean, showing changes in sea surface temperatures relative to a historic baseline. The map uses color coding to indicate temperature anomalies: darker orange areas represent abnormally warm
